notes: «بإسناد يرفعه» is a gap marker: an unnamed link at its place in the order (rule 8)
«أبي عبد الله» sits inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator; the Imam's words follow
«وقال مالك» and «فقال لي» are Malik's own account inside the same saying, not a new route
«إن أبي عليه السلام كان يقول» quotes the Imam's father inside the matn; no chain is written for it, so no link is added
